summary: Iteration 28: P&L Calculation Bug Fix - Fixed critical bug in _position_monitoring_loop where NO position P&L was calculated incorrectly. The bug used entry_price (which is NO price for NO positions) instead of yes_entry_price, causing extreme P&L percentages like +210%. After fix, P&L values are realistic (-1% to -2% range).

minor.issue: ws_updates counter shows 0 - WebSocket may not be receiving price updates from Polymarket

critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: _position_monitoring_loop at line 3166 was using entry_price (display price) instead of yes_entry_price for P&L calculation
For NO positions, entry_price is the NO price, but the calculation assumed it was YES price
Fix: Changed to use yes_entry_price = position.get('yes_entry_price', position['entry_price']) for consistent calculations
WebSocket token mapping fix verified - token mapping is populated before WebSocket starts processing

success_rate.backend: 100% (WebSocket token mapping tests pass, P&L calculation verified)

bug_fix_details.bug_description: NO position P&L was calculated incorrectly, showing extreme percentages like +210%
bug_fix_details.root_cause: _position_monitoring_loop used entry_price (which is NO price for NO positions) instead of yes_entry_price. The calculation no_entry = 1 - entry_price was wrong because entry_price was already the NO price.
bug_fix_details.fix_applied: Changed to use yes_entry_price = position.get('yes_entry_price', position['entry_price']) for consistent P&L calculations
bug_fix_details.verification: After fix, NO positions show realistic P&L: -1.66%, -2.05%, -1.99%
